svg.title: Draw it: three files and their arrows
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw three boxes for the class file, the trainer and the predictor; draw an arrow for every import, including the one arrow that must not exist, crossed out; and mark where the file digits_mlp.pt is written and where it is read.
svg.text: Draw it: three files and their arrows
1. three boxes: the class file, the trainer, the predictor
2. an arrow for every import — and the one arrow that must not exist,
drawn in and then crossed out. Mark where digits_mlp.pt is written and read.
